body.label: Effect
body.html: Manifest the Beast around yourself or one ally within 2 units. The target gains +1 Defense until your next turn.

surges.html: If this Action affects an ally, that ally gains +1 Defense until its next turn.
If you used another Calling subtype earlier this round, gain +1 Defense until your next turn.

rider.title: BEAST — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 4 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 2 additional Mana to fully manifest your Beast.
